Lemma 2: if f <=_lr f', g <=_lr g' and all four are PF2, then f*g <=_lr f'*g'. Proof: reduce by transitivity to one factor at a time; then for v<v', S := (f*g)(v)(f'*g)(v') - (f*g)(v')(f'*g)(v) = sum_{w,w'} f(w)f'(w') Delta(w,w') with Delta antisymmetric, so 2S = sum [f(w)f'(w')-f(w')f'(w)] Delta(w,w'); the first bracket is >=0 for w<w' by f<=_lr f', and Delta(w,w') = g(p)g(p'+delta)-g(p+delta)g(p') >= 0 for p>p' by PF2 of g. Both brackets are antisymmetric and sign-matched, so every term is >=0.
